assertions.assertion: Configures both AddJwtBearer and AddOAuth2Introspection handlers
assertions.rationale: Both AddJwtBearer("Bearer", ...) and AddOAuth2Introspection("Introspection", ...) are configured.

assertions.assertion: Uses ForwardReferenceToken (via Selector.ForwardReferenceToken) to route reference tokens to the introspection handler
assertions.rationale: Routing is done with a hand-written ForwardDefaultSelector delegate that checks for a dot; it never uses the Duende Selector.ForwardReferenceToken helper.

assertions.assertion: The scheme name passed to ForwardReferenceToken matches the scheme name used in AddOAuth2Introspection
assertions.rationale: There is no ForwardReferenceToken call. (The manual selector does return "Introspection" matching the introspection scheme, but the assertion specifically requires ForwardReferenceToken, which is absent.)

assertions.assertion: Sets ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' on the JWT bearer handler
assertions.rationale: It only suggests 'consider validating the token type'; ValidTypes = ["at+jwt"] is never actually set.
Uses Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer plus the Duende introspection package; the Duende.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer package is not mentioned.
